companyProfile.title: Company profile
companyProfile.subtitle: Your public-facing company information.
companyProfile.permissionBody: You don't have permission to edit the company profile.
companyProfile.sectionIntro: Keep this up to date — students see it on your job posts and profile.
companyProfile.conflictBody: This profile was changed elsewhere. We've reloaded the latest version.
companyProfile.logoIntro: Shown on your job posts, company page and search results.
companyProfile.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to about 3 MB.
companyProfile.logoRemoveBody: Students will see the initials placeholder until you upload a new logo.

logoErr.emptyFile: The file is empty. Please choose a valid image.
logoErr.tooLarge: The image is too large. Please choose a file under 3 MB.
logoErr.unsupportedType: Unsupported format. Please use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
logoErr.conflict: The profile changed elsewhere. We've reloaded the latest version — please try again.
logoErr.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
logoErr.generic: Couldn't update the logo. Please try again.

companyProfile.aiInsightNoLogo: Upload a company logo — profiles with logos receive significantly more candidate views
companyProfile.aiInsightNoDescription: Add an 'About' section — students look for company culture and values before applying
companyProfile.aiInsightNoWebsite: Add your website URL — candidates want to learn more about your company
companyProfile.aiInsightNoIndustry: Set your industry — it helps students discover you through industry-based filters
companyProfile.aiInsightComplete: Your company profile is complete! Keep it updated to stay relevant to top candidates.
